business.name: Example Plumbing
business.description: Family-owned plumbing company serving the greater Portland area since 2009. Licensed and insured. Free estimates for most jobs.
business.hours: Monday to Friday 7am-6pm, Saturday 8am-2pm, closed Sunday. 24/7 emergency service at a higher rate.

instructions.extra: If a caller describes active flooding, a burst pipe, or no water at all, treat it as urgent and notify the owner immediately after getting their address and callback number.

receptionist.greeting: Thanks for calling Example Plumbing, this is Alex. How can I help you today?
